descriptionChirho: To stretch out or spread abroad something vast, such as the heavens or the earth (Qal and Hifil stems).
To stamp with the feet or trample down enemies, crushing them flat (Qal stem, including beating down foes).
To beat or hammer metal into thin sheets or plates, as in metalworking (Piel active and Pual passive stems).
To plate or overlay an object by spreading hammered metal over it (Piel stem, specialized metalworking sense).
